Aten Ra.eyeColor: glowing electrum-gold with lapis-blue inner ring — solar law eyes that radiate warm golden light, the pupils are not human but glowing solar discs of amber-gold. The eyes emit actual visible light in gold and deep blue.

Asgardian.eyeColor: glowing blue-white lightning — storm eyes that crackle with electric blue-white energy, the irises are not human but burning blue-white storm-light. The eyes emit actual visible blue-white electric light, like captured lightning.

Olympian.eyeColor: glowing bronze-gold with sky-blue inner ring — civic glory eyes that radiate warm bronze and sky-blue light, the pupils are not human but burning bronze-gold discs. The eyes emit actual visible bronze and sky-blue light.

Kami.eyeColor: glowing foxfire-blue-green with torii-red inner ring — sacred threshold eyes that burn with spirit-fire, the irises are not human but glowing foxfire-blue-green with deep red shrine-light at the center. The eyes emit actual visible blue-green and red spirit-light.

Tuatha.eyeColor: glowing silver-green sidhe light — fae memory eyes that shimmer with metallic silver and living green energy, the irises are not human but swirling silver-green fae-fire. The eyes emit actual visible silver and green light.

Empyrean.eyeColor: glowing seraph-gold with many-eye-blue inner pattern — choir order eyes that radiate divine gold with blue awareness-points flickering within, the pupils are not human but opal-glass discs with gold and blue light. The eyes emit actual visible gold and iridescent blue light.

Infernal Dominion.eyeColor: glowing hellfire-red-orange with brass-gold inner ring — contract power eyes that burn with molten infernal fire, the irises are not human but burning hellfire-red with brass-gold at the center. The eyes emit actual visible red-orange and brass-gold molten light.
